description: This file defines the LabelValue class, which encapsulates a label's value and its comment within the LabelManager module of the WebTools component in the OFBiz framework. It provides getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: LabelValue
classes.description: A class representing a label's value and comment, used within the label management system of OFBiz WebTools.

methods.name: LabelValue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the label value and comment.
